trigger: The final-subject features were almost unchanged in their physical contrast when text was swapped (2.23% antisymmetric energy on fit). More admitted subject duels improved source ranking but hurt ordinary single-sentence localization. Move measurement upstream to where the sentence changes both proposal positions and their vote weights.
intervention: Native full sentence F and its text-parsed subject category C share exact sampled input points, frozen backbone features and ordered query seed coordinates fixed by F. F/C can each move downstream proposal geometry and can each assign the weights of those same 256 native seeds. Never join unrelated query numbers. Keep v1's original physical four output boxes, full-sentence downstream decoder logits, and PCA.
statistic: For fixed anchor i, G in {F,C} selects proposal geometry, W in {F,C} selects seed weights. U_GW(i)=sum_j IoU6(i,B_Gj)/density_Gj * p_Wj; density is native squared overlap sum. I_i=log U_FF-log U_FC-log U_CF+log U_CC. Compute only when both geometry systems support i. Preserve total probability mass on the supported subset under each score edit, leave unsupported logits unchanged. A parse failure or fewer than two supported anchors gives exact v1. I is a factorial interaction, not known to be harmful. Its two main effects are kept.
calibration: For a shared physical pair, regress the paired common nuisance margin on each sentence's I(a)-I(b) using all eligible correct Waymo TRAIN pairs on the two-nomination probe, one scalar in [0,1]. Permute the full-to-category log weight ratios across fixed seeds inside each input for a negative control. Category-prior baseline subtracts source-calibrated log U_CC with the same information/budget. All three calibrated coefficients fit independently by the same closed form, never on target labels. Constant full removal additionally reported.
source: Original 213 fit and 44 calibration potential pairs, plus the previously evaluated 142 pairs / 80 Waymo VAL recordings. Report all unconditional denominators, support counts, two-way and four-way success and paired changes. Separately compare on the original single-sentence four-slot nominations for each source expression. No target truth enters parsing, candidate selection, or calibration.
target: Run all locked arms on 5,528 ordinary Waymo-origin target records, even if the learned coefficient clips to zero. Reuse original physical geometry, one natural input sentence, zero target updates; category text is derived from the input, one extra text-conditioned frozen replay using shared seed positions. Keep original failures and all fallbacks. Distinguish a useful method from a measurable interaction: examine accuracy vs v1, vs same-compute shuffled control and category-only correction, both directions and recordings. If weight zero or controls match, do not claim the interaction helps. No FINAL.
implementation_checks: Parity of native scores/anchors, full-to-full forced-seed replay on a sample, constant fold-change and identical geometry yield zero interaction, conservation of supported mass, identical registered filtered ordinary roster.
